title: Import a README
description: Start with the README you already have. Review a local conversion before replacing your draft.
privacy: Your file stays in this browser. Reviewing does not load images, contact GitHub or send your writing to a service.
sourceHelp: Paste the complete README, including any HTML. Nothing changes in your draft until you confirm.
sourceLimit: Up to {bodyLimit} characters for ordinary Markdown or {sourceLimit} for a README with app recovery data. Some emoji count as two characters.
fileHelp: Choose a UTF-8 .md file, up to {limit} KB. It is read locally and never uploaded.
fileLoaded: File opened: {name}. Review the text, then analyze it.
fileTypeError: Choose a Markdown file ending in .md.
fileSizeError: This file is too large. Choose a .md file smaller than {limit} KB.
fileEncodingError: This file could not be read as UTF-8 text. Save it as UTF-8 and try again.
fileReadError: Your file could not be opened. Try again or paste its Markdown below.
reviewHelp: Review each proposed module destination and conversion. Sections without a clear match remain custom. Nothing changes until you confirm.
customDestination: This content will be kept as a custom section.
keepAsCustom: Keep this content as a custom section instead

moduleProposalReasons.profile_header: The opening name and introduction match the profile header structure.
moduleProposalReasons.technology_catalog_list: The list matches known technologies and tools.
moduleProposalReasons.project_link_list: The linked entries match the project format.
moduleProposalReasons.contribution_link_list: The linked entries match the contribution format.
moduleProposalReasons.contact_links: These links match common contact destinations.

moduleHintReasons.manifest_reference: The app's section marker identifies this as {module}, but its content cannot be mapped to those fixed fields without losing information. It will stay a custom section.
moduleHintReasons.heading_alias: The heading resembles {module}, but this content cannot be mapped to its fields safely. It will stay a custom section.

recovery.snapshotMatch: This README contains a validated copy of the full profile, and its visible Markdown is unchanged. Exact restore is selected by default.
recovery.snapshotEdited: A saved profile is available, but this README's visible Markdown has changed. Choose whether to restore the saved profile or import the edited text.
recovery.structural: This README has app-generated section markers, so supported sections can return to their original modules. It does not contain a full profile copy.
recovery.structuralEdited: This README has app-generated markers, but its text has changed. The old section positions will not be used; review the best-effort module suggestions instead.
recovery.invalid: A recovery marker was found but could not be validated. The original source is preserved; review the Markdown as a best-effort import.
recovery.unsupported: This README uses a newer recovery format. Its original source is preserved; review the Markdown as a best-effort import.
recovery.bestEffort: No valid app recovery marker was found. Suggestions use headings and content structure; review each destination and notice.
recovery.exactOption: Restore the full saved profile, including hidden sections.
recovery.markdownOption: Import the visible Markdown into modules and custom sections.
recovery.snapshotReady: Exact saved profile selected. It replaces the current draft as a whole after confirmation; section selections do not apply.
recovery.snapshotReviewHelp: Review whether to restore the saved profile or import the visible Markdown content.
recovery.snapshotValidButExportNeedsAttention: The saved profile is valid and can be restored. Some README export settings may need review afterward.
recovery.confirmSnapshotHelp: This restores the profile captured when the README was exported. It replaces your current profile and does not merge. The current profile and exact imported .md will be backed up first.
recovery.confirmSnapshotLabel: I want to restore the full saved profile from this README.
recovery.confirmSnapshot: Back up draft and restore profile

reviewCount: {count, plural, one {# section selected} other {# sections selected}} of {total}
reviewReady: Sections detected. Review their conversion and any notices before continuing.
noRemotePreview: This is text only. Images and HTML will be displayed in the editor after you confirm.
excluded: {count, plural, one {# section is explicitly excluded} other {# sections are explicitly excluded}}. Excluded content will not enter the editor; the complete original will be kept in the import backup.
blockedHelp: Correct the source and detect sections again, or explicitly exclude the sections with problems.
stale: The source or README language changed. Detect sections again before importing.
confirmHelp: This replaces your current profile, including hidden sections. It does not merge with the existing draft.
backupHelp: The previous profile configuration and the complete imported Markdown will be saved as one local backup. Open this importer again to download or restore it.
backupReplace: There is already an import backup. Confirming replaces that backup. Download it first if you want to keep it.
confirmLabel: I reviewed the conversion and exclusions, and want to replace my current profile.
backupAvailable: Contains the profile from before your last import and the complete Markdown you imported. This is one local backup, not a history or a remote copy.
backupInvalid: The saved import backup could not be validated. Its saved record stays untouched. You can continue only in memory after explicitly confirming.
backupUnavailable: The browser could not read your saved import backup. Any backup available in memory can still be downloaded below.
downloadError: The download could not be started. Try again before leaving the page.
restoreTitle: Restore the profile from this backup?
restoreHelp: This replaces your current work with the backed-up profile. The original Markdown and this backup are kept. Download your current README first if you want to keep its latest edits.
restoreLabel: I want to replace my current work with the previous profile.
memoryTitle: The browser could not save this change
memoryHelp: Your current profile has been kept. A backup may already have been saved. You can continue in memory, but unsaved changes and this backup may be lost when you reload or close the tab. Download both backup files before leaving.
operationInvalid: The profile could not be applied safely. Detect sections again and review the result. Your current draft has been kept.
operationNotReady: Your current draft is still loading. Wait a moment and try again.

problems.empty_source: Paste some Markdown or open a .md file first.
problems.source_too_large: The Markdown exceeds the import limit. Shorten it before analyzing it again.
problems.too_complex: This document is too complex to import safely in one step. Try a smaller README.
problems.parse_failed: The Markdown could not be analyzed. Review the source and try again.
problems.invalid_url: A link or image uses a URL that this editor does not allow. Use an absolute web address.
problems.relative_url: A link or image uses a relative path. Replace it with its full public URL before importing; a repository address cannot be guessed.
problems.anchor_link: A link points to a section anchor. Replace or remove it explicitly: the imported headings may use different anchors.
problems.missing_image_alt: An image needs an alternative description before it can be imported.
problems.invalid_html: This HTML does not meet the editor's rules. Review its links, images and structure, or exclude this section.
problems.unsupported_format: Some content in this section cannot be represented safely. Correct the original or explicitly exclude the section.
problems.empty_section: This section has no importable content. Review the original or exclude it.
problems.no_sections_selected: Select at least one section to import.
problems.invalid_selection: The section selection is no longer valid. Detect sections again.
problems.invalid_document: The converted profile does not meet the document rules. Review the source before trying again.
problems.generation_failed: The converted profile cannot generate a valid README yet. Correct or exclude the sections with problems.
problems.snapshot_unavailable: The saved profile snapshot is unavailable or did not pass validation. Import the Markdown instead or use a project JSON file.

notices.markdown_normalized: Markdown spacing or syntax is normalized. Compare the resulting text before importing.
notices.converted_to_html: Formatting is preserved in an HTML block. You can edit its HTML in the editor; it is not a visual table or rich-text editor.
notices.retained_html: The original HTML is kept in an explicit HTML block and checked against the editor's HTML policy.
notices.grouped_html_context: Related HTML content is kept together to preserve its structure.
notices.references_resolved: Referenced links or images are resolved using definitions in the complete original.
notices.code_metadata_removed: Code is preserved, but additional fence metadata is not exported. A nested code fragment converted to HTML also loses its language label.
notices.html_unsupported_elements: Unsupported HTML elements are filtered from the result. Review what remains before importing.
notices.html_unsupported_attributes: Unsupported HTML attributes, including styling, are removed from the result.
notices.html_comments_removed: HTML comments are removed from the resulting README; the original keeps them.
notices.html_repaired_html: Malformed HTML is repaired. Review the resulting structure before importing.
notices.module_mapping_not_confirmed: A possible module match is uncertain, so this content remains a custom section.
notices.module_mapping_conflict: Several sections match the same module. They remain separate custom sections instead of being merged silently.
notices.manifest_invalid: The app recovery data could not be validated and will not be used.
notices.manifest_unsupported: The app recovery data uses a format this version cannot read.
notices.manifest_stale: The visible README has changed since its saved profile snapshot was created.
